label: Mainland China (enterprise employees)
verify_before_use: Re-read the official text before any filing. Local rules (minimum wage, local average wage, holiday calendar, special working-hour systems) change and are set by city/province.
overtime_source: Labour Law art. 44; paid days per month 21.75 per the 2008 MOHRSS notice on monthly working days
leave_tiers_note: [min cumulative working years, days]; under 1 year of total work history = 0 days
leave_source: Regulation on Paid Annual Leave art. 3 and 5 (unused days paid at 300% of daily wage, of which 100% is already in normal pay); Implementing Measures art. 10 and 12 (pro-rating, fractions of a day dropped)
severance_source: Labour Contract Law art. 47 (N), art. 40 (one extra month in lieu of notice), art. 48/87 (2N for unlawful termination)
no_contract_source: Labour Contract Law art. 82 (no written contract after the first month: double wage, at most 11 months)
claim_window_source: Labour Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law art. 27: one year from when the worker knew or should have known; unpaid wages during employment run from the end of employment
